sources.outlet: Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors (motion by Supervisor Horvath)
sources.quote: Historically these businesses have been concentrated in Glendale and Burbank, but of late there has been a significant increase in the number of operations located in the Van Nuys area of Los Angeles County (County).
sources.searcher_note: County motion: 3,170 home health and 1,623 hospice agencies in LA County; names Glendale, Burbank and Van Nuys (the ZIP 912-916 area) as the concentration. No enrollment-year split, no 35%/3% figures.

sources.quote: Medicare-certified home health agency supply continued to grow in 2024, but much of that expansion was concentrated in California
sources.searcher_note: Post-cutoff. Reports MedPAC July 2026 Data Book: HHA growth concentrated in California, 'particularly Los Angeles County'; excluding California, HHA supply fell ~1% 2019-2024. County level, not ZIP 912-916.

sources.quote: number of home health agencies delivering services increased from 896 to 1,309
sources.searcher_note: Earliest found. Los Angeles County HHAs delivering services rose 896 to 1,309 (about 46%) from start of 2019 to June 2023, while the national count fell 8,838 to 8,280 (about 6%). Data from an unnamed industry source on Medicare claims. County level, not ZIP 912-916.

sources.quote: Los Angeles County currently has approximately 12% to 15% of all HHA enrollments nationwide, despite being the place of residence of approximately 3% of the US
sources.searcher_note: Summarises CMS's May 2026 nationwide HHA enrollment moratorium notice (Federal Register 2026-09717), which cited LA County's 40%+ rise in HHA enrollment 2019-2023. Federal Register page itself blocked by a bot wall; Greenberg Traurig and Benesch pages carry the same 40% figure.

sources.quote: Assemblywoman Alexandra Macedo, R-Tulare, said the agencies are registered at 14545 Friar St., where she said she visited the property after reviewing licensing records.
sources.searcher_note: Names 14545 Friar St. as the registered address for 197 hospice agencies (state licensing records, per the lawmaker). Lead counts 49 home health agencies and 9 hospices there from the CMS still-enrolled file; different source and definition. Article is about hospices only, no home health.

sources.quote: 89 hospice companies registered at a single Van Nuys office plaza and 210 agencies concentrated within one square mile of the San Fernando Valley
sources.searcher_note: Covers the county motion; San Fernando Valley clustering of agencies; more than 4,700 home health and hospice agencies operate in the county. No enrollment-year split.

notes: Coverage of the LA home health surge is broad at county level: CMS's May 2026 moratorium notice (via law-firm summaries), MedPAC's July 2026 Data Book (via HHCN, post-cutoff), and HHCN's Jan 2024 claims-data story. The LA County motion is the only source found that names the Glendale/Burbank/Van Nuys area specifically. No source found gives the ZIP 912-916 split, the 35% (enrolled 2019+) vs 3% (before 2013) comparison, or the 49 home health agencies at 14545 Friar St. The Friar St building is covered for hospices (NBC LA: 197 hospice registrations; CBS News, 2026-03-19, reported 89 licensed hospices at the Merabi Professional Medical Plaza in Van Nuys but did not print a street address, so it is not recorded as naming this building). FinCEN's Sept 2026 health-care-fraud trend analysis lists Glendale, Van Nuys, Burbank and North Hollywood among top cities in suspicious-activity reports, a different measure.
